    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Lua:善用luarocks管理公共库</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>本文分享自天翼云开发者社区《<a href="https://www.ctyun.cn/developer/article/611294567211077" rel="noopener nofollow">Lua善用luarocks管理公共库</a>》.作者：王****淋</p>
<h2>什么是Luarocks</h2>
<p>Luarocks是一个Lua包管理器，基于 Lua 语言开发，提供一个命令行的方式来管理 Lua 包依赖、安装第三方 Lua 包等，社区比较流行的包管理器之一</p>
<p>Python具有PIP，Ruby具有Gems，Java具有Maven，Node具有npm，Lua具有Luarocks。</p>
<h2>前要：先看Lua的require</h2>
<p>以openresty中的Luajit<code>/usr/local/openresty/luajit/bin/luajit</code>为例：</p>
<h3>测试代码：</h3>
<pre class="language-lua"><code class="language-lua hljs" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-keyword">local cjson = <span class="hljs-built_in">require <span class="hljs-string">"cjson"
<span class="hljs-keyword">local s = cjson.encode({<span class="hljs-string">"test", <span class="hljs-string">"lua", <span class="hljs-string">"package"})
<span class="hljs-built_in">print(s)
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3>执行结果：</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-swift" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-regexp">/usr/local<span class="hljs-regexp">/openresty/luajit<span class="hljs-regexp">/bin/luajit: test.lua:<span class="hljs-number">3: module 'cjson' not found:

</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p>从测试结果可以看到，require有几个搜索目录，理论上任意目录都可以</p>
<h2>Luarocks包管理</h2>
<p>我们软件开发过程中会引入大量库。如果简单把所有库都放入代码仓，那会造成大量的混乱。因此，更适合的办法是，使用luarocks包管理工具，将库安装到库目录。</p>
<h3>示例：luarocks 安装 cjson</h3>
<p>以openresty中的Luajit<code>/usr/local/openresty/luajit/bin/luajit</code>为例：</p>
<p><code>/usr/local/openresty/luajit/bin/luarocks install lua-cjson</code></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-apache" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-attribute">Installing /luarocks.org/lua-cjson-<span class="hljs-number">2.1.0.10-<span class="hljs-number">1.src.rock

<span class="hljs-attribute">lua-cjson <span class="hljs-number">2.1.0.10-<span class="hljs-number">1 depends <span class="hljs-literal">on lua &gt;= <span class="hljs-number">5.<span class="hljs-number">1 (<span class="hljs-number">5.<span class="hljs-number">1-<span class="hljs-number">1 provided by VM)
<span class="hljs-attribute">gcc -O2 -fPIC -I/usr/local/openresty/luajit/include/luajit-<span class="hljs-number">2.<span class="hljs-number">1 -c lua_cjson.c -o lua_cjson.o
<span class="hljs-attribute">gcc -O2 -fPIC -I/usr/local/openresty/luajit/include/luajit-<span class="hljs-number">2.<span class="hljs-number">1 -c strbuf.c -o strbuf.o
<span class="hljs-attribute">gcc -O2 -fPIC -I/usr/local/openresty/luajit/include/luajit-<span class="hljs-number">2.<span class="hljs-number">1 -c fpconv.c -o fpconv.o
<span class="hljs-attribute">gcc -shared -o cjson.so lua_cjson.o strbuf.o fpconv.o
<span class="hljs-attribute">No existing manifest. Attempting to rebuild...
<span class="hljs-attribute">lua-cjson <span class="hljs-number">2.1.0.10-<span class="hljs-number">1 is now installed in /usr/local/openresty/luajit (license: MIT)
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<pre class="language-sh"><code class="language-sh hljs language-bash" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-comment"># find /usr/local/openresty/luajit -name cjson.so 
/usr/local/openresty/luajit/lib/lua/5.1/cjson.so
</span></code></pre>
<h3>luarocks 安装nettle</h3>
<pre class="language-sh"><code class="language-sh hljs language-bash" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-comment"># find /usr/local/openresty/luajit -name *nettle*
/usr/local/openresty/luajit/lib/luarocks/rocks-5.1/lua-resty-nettle
/usr/local/openresty/luajit/lib/luarocks/rocks-5.1/lua-resty-nettle/2.1-1/lua-resty-nettle-2.1-1.rockspec
/usr/local/openresty/luajit/share/lua/5.1/resty/nettle
/usr/local/openresty/luajit/share/lua/5.1/resty/nettle/types/nettle-types.lua
/usr/local/openresty/luajit/share/lua/5.1/resty/nettle.lua</span></code></pre>
